headline: A Zoom Screen-Sharing Bug Let Anyone Take Over Other Devices on a Call
context: Researchers say it took fewer than 20 prompts for a public AI tool to find a flaw (now fixed) allowing anyone on a Zoom call to hijack another participants’ device.
